summary: The familiar pull-down-at-the-top-of-a-list gesture, with a configurable indicator.
overview: The gesture every mobile app uses: already scrolled to the very top, keep dragging down, and releasing past a threshold fires a refresh. Three ways to supply the indicator — a fully hand-built hierarchy, a prefab, or just a sprite it builds an Image from.
useCases: Reloading a leaderboard or news feed.
Re-fetching server data in a mobile-style UI.
Any list a player expects to be able to refresh by pulling.

params.tuning: Too small and ordinary over-scroll triggers a refresh by accident.
Takes priority over the prefab and sprite options. Supply only one of the three.

gotchas.title: You must call EndRefresh
gotchas.body: It fires the event and waits. If your reload never signals completion, the indicator stays up forever.
